flow.name: customer-lookup-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: customer_lookup
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that retrieves a customer record by customerId or email

mcp:tool-listener.name: customer_lookup
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: customer_lookup
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers customer_lookup tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Look up a customer record by customerId (e.g. CUST-101) or email address. Supply exactly one of the two parameters.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred during customer lookup.'}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract customerId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional customerId from tool call input

set-variable.doc:name: Extract email
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional email from tool call input

choice.doc:name: Validate Input
choice.doc:description: Ensures at least customerId or email is supplied

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'Provide either customerId or email to look up a customer.'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Missing Input Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds INVALID_INPUT error when neither customerId nor email is supplied

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INVALID_INPUT
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates error so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error

ee:transform.doc:name: Find Customer
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads mock-customers.json and returns the matching customer or null

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var allCustomers = readUrl("classpath://mock-customers.json", "application/json") var byId = if (vars.lookupCustomerId != '') allCustomers filter ($.customerId == vars.lookupCustomerId) else allCustomers var byEmail = if (vars.lookupEmail != '') byId filter (lower($.email) == lower(vars.lookupEmail)) else byId --- if (sizeOf(byEmail) > 0) byEmail[0] else null

choice.doc:name: Customer Found?
choice.doc:description: Routes to success or raises CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No customer was found matching the supplied criteria.', customerId: (vars.lookupCustomerId default ''), email: (vars.lookupEmail default '')}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Not Found Error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] customer_lookup | customerId=' ++ (payload.customerId default '') ++ ' | name=' ++ (payload.name default '')]
logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.doc:description: Logs successful customer lookup with customerId and name

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle INVALID_INPUT
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates INVALID_INPUT so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] customer_lookup | INVALID_INPUT - no customerId or email supplied']
logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Input

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] customer_lookup | CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND | customerId=' ++ (vars.lookupCustomerId default '') ++ ' | email=' ++ (vars.lookupEmail default '')]
logger.doc:name: Log Not Found
